443:t_1:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...It is an honor to meet you at last, Your Majesty $$ディアナ・ソレル$$.」

443:t_1:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I am $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$. I serve as Supreme Commander of the $$新地球皇国$$ forces.」

443:t_1:7.en:
$$ポゥ$$
(So this is the woman... the $$ストラウス$$ of the $$サイデリアル$$...)

443:t_1:8.en:
$$ハリー$$
(With those bold yet meticulous strategies, the forces defending both Earths were torn to shreds...)

443:t_1:9.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Supreme Commander $$バーンストラウス$$...」

443:t_1:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Please call me $$エルーナルーナ$$, Your Majesty.」

443:t_1:11.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Very well, $$エルーナルーナ$$... Withdraw your forces from this moon at once.」

443:t_1:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That I cannot do. I too am acting on the orders of $$アウストラリス$$, the Emperor of the Empire.」

443:t_1:13.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Orders...? An ill-fitting word for a bloodthirsty warmonger.」

443:t_1:15.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Looking at you, I am reminded of a man of the warrior class who was once in charge of defending this moon.」

443:t_1:16.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「That man, too, moved his troops in the name of duty, yet in truth he was the kind of person who rejoiced that an age had come to wield his power.」

443:t_1:17.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Are you trying to say that I am the same?」

443:t_1:19.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You see right through everything, huh? Man, you got me... That's some sharp eye you've got.」

443:t_1:20.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Mind your tongue...! You are in the presence of Her Majesty!」

443:t_1:21.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Wanna go, Red Specs? I can have my fun even without a machine, you know.」

443:t_1:22.en:
$$ハリー$$
「If that is your wish, I will answer with a duel.」

443:t_1:23.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「That is enough, $$ハリー$$. Just because a stray dog barked at you, there is no need to lower yourself into a dog as well.」

443:t_1:24.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's quite a thing to say, $$ディアナ$$.」

443:t_1:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If it's come to this, there's no point in putting on an act. I'll be my real self from here on.」

443:t_1:26.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「That is better. It will be easier to communicate.」

443:t_1:27.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So, about you telling me to go home earlier... The answer's still NO.」

443:t_1:28.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「My mission is to get my hands on that facility on the moon, 《$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$》.」

443:t_1:29.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「So that is what you are after...」

443:t_1:30.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Apparently, running that facility takes the Queen's approval. ...No dice?」

443:t_1:31.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「There is no need to answer that.」

443:t_1:33.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Honestly, if $$アウストラリス$$ thinks that thing is in the way, he could just smash it. What a pain of a guy.」

443:t_1:34.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Is $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ not your lord?」

443:t_1:35.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「On paper, he is.」

443:t_1:36.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That guy... is a surprising romantic, you know. He seems to have a policy of cherishing anything with history, like ruins and relics.」

443:t_1:37.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So, hassle or not, I'm supposed to deal with it without bloodshed. Easy for him to say.」

443:t_1:38.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You say that, after seizing $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ and this 《$$ゲンガナム$$》 by force.」

443:t_1:39.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If you had a problem with that, you should have resisted with everything you had. You've got a decent force here too, so you shouldn't have surrendered right away.」

443:t_1:40.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's what I was hoping for. If you had, I could've had a fun fight with that Red Specs over there.」

443:t_1:41.en:
$$ハリー$$
「A warmonger like you could never understand Her Majesty's heart.」

443:t_1:42.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm not that dumb. ...The Queen ran up the white flag so fast to stop you guys from a suicide charge, didn't she?」

443:t_1:44.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I can tell just by looking at you. The people here wouldn't give a damn about their own lives if it's for the Queen's sake.」

443:t_1:45.en:
$$ハリー$$
(She's worthy of the title of Supreme Commander... So she's more than just a bloodthirsty beast.)

443:t_1:46.en:
$$ディアナ$$
($$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$... I can feel in my bones how terrifying the Empire must be, to have her in its ranks...)

443:t_1:47.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Such a shame, $$ディアナ$$. Now that I know you're no mere coward, I want to fight you all the more.」

443:t_1:49.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's not what I mean. Fighting isn't just about holding guns and blazing away.」

443:t_1:50.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Fighting the warriors who protect you with their lives is, in a sense, fighting you.」

443:t_1:52.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Guess my all-out love call didn't get through...」

443:t_1:53.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then let's sit back and enjoy watching the fight between the $c you trust and the $$ハイアデス$$, led by my right hand, $$ダバラーン$$.」

443:t_1:54.en:
$$ハリー$$
「You had noticed the approach of $c.」

443:t_1:55.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Of course. Gathering intel is basic manners before you step onto a battlefield.」

443:t_1:56.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh... don't worry. I don't have the slightest intention of using a cheap trick like taking you hostage.」

443:t_1:57.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$...」

443:t_1:58.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Besides, you're practically family to the $$サイデリアル$$, $$ディアナ$$.」

443:t_1:60.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The last descendant of the $$クロノ$$, $$ディアナ・ソレル$$...」

443:t_1:62.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I salute your ancestors, $$ディアナ$$, who tried to bring back an Earth that had lost everything.」

443:t_2:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ガロード$$, have you guys been here before?」

443:t_2:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「During the $$多元戦争$$ in the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

443:t_2:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's where we first learned that the world we came from is the future of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

443:t_2:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The era called $$黒歴史$$... In other words, just what is the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s worst future?」

443:t_2:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I hear the world $$ロラン$$ and the others came from suffered a disaster on a scale that caused civilization to decline. Is that what it refers to?」

443:t_2:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「Allow me to tell the rest from here.」

443:t_2:12.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

443:t_2:13.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why do you come into this?」

443:t_2:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Because I am the one who started the $$黒歴史$$.」

443:t_2:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「To be precise, it was one of my possibilities.」

443:t_2:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「That me fought $$アムロ$$ and the others and dropped $$アクシズ$$ on the Earth.」

443:t_2:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The correct history $$フル・フロンタル$$ spoke of...」

443:t_2:19.en:
$$シャア$$
「Whether the vision that man saw was that, I cannot say.」

443:t_2:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I, who fought in the $$多元戦争$$, may well have stepped onto such a path, had there been some trigger.」

443:t_2:21.en:
$$レド$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ dropped a meteor...」

バーンストラウス.evidence: Surname of glossary entry エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス (Elunaluna Burnstraus, female); Dianna addresses her as Supreme Commander Burnstraus in 443:t_1:9
